opening.argument: The presentation is a straightforward instructional guide to using Taobao, beginning with the stated purpose of learning how to use the app. It walks viewers through ordinary retail steps: adding an item to a cart, providing delivery details, entering an Alipay password, selecting an Alipay balance, and completing purchases. The discussion of reviews is cautionary rather than promotional, expressly warning viewers that some reviews can be bought and advising them not to believe every review they read. Although affiliate links are disclosed, they are not connected to a deceptive offer or a required financial scheme; the payment flow remains ordinary online shopping.
